# Alba Wellbeing

> Alba Wellbeing is Lina Simavičiūtė (known as Alba), a medically trained, self-employed live-in carer based in Louth, Lincolnshire, UK. She lives with the person she cares for in their own home, offering personal care, companionship, rehabilitation support and end-of-life companionship, with optional hypnotherapy, therapeutic massage, Reiki and breathing sessions. The first conversation is free; fees are agreed individually.

Key facts:
- Who: Lina Simavičiūtė, known as Alba. Originally from Lithuania, permanent right to live and work in the UK. Speaks English, Lithuanian and Russian.
- Experience: five years of care in UK homes. Medically trained and professionally qualified. Self-employed (arranged directly, not through an agency). References available on request. Full driving licence.
- Conditions supported: dementia, Parkinson's disease, stroke, cancer, Down syndrome, reduced mobility, complex care needs, palliative and end-of-life care.
- Area: Louth, Lincolnshire, the surrounding area and further afield. Hypnotherapy online anywhere in the UK, or in person near Louth.
- Not provided: regulated nursing or medical treatment. Lina works alongside GPs, district nurses and hospice teams.
- Contact: +44 7300 403632 (call or text), albalinasima25@icloud.com
- Motto: Professional knowledge. Human presence. A happy we.

## Services

- [Live-in care and companionship](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/live-in-care.html): what live-in care is, what Lina helps with, conditions, costs (agreed individually) and FAQs
- [End-of-life and palliative companionship](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/end-of-life.html): companionship at home and respite for families, alongside GP, district nurses and hospice
- [Hypnotherapy and wellbeing sessions](https://www.albawellbeing.co.uk/hypnotherapy.html): hypnotherapy for anxiety, stress, sleep and confidence; therapeutic massage, Reiki, breathing
